content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity review is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), denied under CO-197 because prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack, with a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia. Monitoring was ordered to capture real-time electrocardiographic data during symptom onset and correlate the episodic symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances."}
